definition: A flat, broad muscle in the calf of the leg that lies beneath the gastrocnemius muscle and helps to plantar flex the foot (point the toes downward).
translation: 比目魚肌（小腿後側的一條扁平肌肉，位於腓腸肌下方，協助足部蹠屈）
example: Strengthening your soleus muscle through calf raises can improve your running performance and ankle stability.
